acquisition_method.evidence: The MS instrument was equipped with an EASY-spray ion source (Thermo Scientific) and was operated in DDA-mode (data-dependent-acquisition).

alkylation_concentration.evidence: The flow-through was discard and 100 μl 50mM iodoacetamide in 8M urea was added and the filters were incubated in dark for 20 minutes followed by centrifugation.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: The flow-through was discard and 100 μl 50mM iodoacetamide in 8M urea was added and the filters were incubated in dark for 20 minutes followed by centrifugation.

cleavage_agent.evidence: 75 μl trypsin diluted in ammonium bicarbonate (Enzyme/protein ratio 1:50).
Trypsin was set as the enzyme, and a maximum of one missed cleavage was allowed.

collision_energy.evidence: The 15 most intense eluting peptides above intensity threshold 5e4, and charge states 2 or higher, were sequentially isolated to a target AGC value of 1e5, resolution R = 30,000, IT of 45 ms and normalized collision energy of 28 %.

ionization_type.evidence: The MS instrument was equipped with an EASY-spray ion source (Thermo Scientific) and was operated in DDA-mode (data-dependent-acquisition).

labeling.evidence: The samples were processed (as described below) and analyzed by LC-MS/MS in a regular label free proteomics workflow.
quantification: MS1 intensity based label-free quantification method

ptm.evidence: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine was set as fixed and oxidation of methionine as variable modification.
Carbamidomethylation of cysteine was set as fixed and oxidation of methionine as variable modification.

reduction_concentration.evidence: The excised bladder tissue was cut into smaller pieces using a scalpel and added 5 μl lysis buffer (4% SDS, 0.1M DTT, 0.1 M Tris/HCl pH 7.6) per mg tissue.

reduction_reagent.evidence: The excised bladder tissue was cut into smaller pieces using a scalpel and added 5 μl lysis buffer (4% SDS, 0.1M DTT, 0.1 M Tris/HCl pH 7.6) per mg tissue.
